description.description: An aerial view showing a massive crowd of protesters gathered on a multi-lane highway in Minneapolis, Minnesota. A red semi-truck with a silver tanker trailer is seen driving into the middle of the crowd, causing people to scramble and eventually surround the vehicle. The footage tracks the movement of the truck as it comes to a stop amidst the dense gathering of people.
